
<html lang="ckb" dir="rtl">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>کراڤا | شەربەتی تازە و چیپسی ترسکە — شەقامی کاوە</title>
<meta name="description" content="کراڤا — شەربەتی تازە و چیپسی ترسکە، تەنها بۆ بردنەوە، لە شەقامی کاوە.">
<link rel="icon" href="data:image/png;base64,">

<!-- Google Fonts: Noto Kufi Arabic (display) + Vazirmatn (body) — both have full Kurdish Sorani glyph coverage -->
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Noto+Kufi+Arabic:wght@500;700;800;900&family=Vazirmatn:wght@400;500;600;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">

<style>
/* =========================================================================
   CRAVA — Fresh Juice & Crispy Fries — Kawa Street
   Single-file responsive site. Sections: Nav, Hero, Juices, Fries, Sauces, Footer
   ========================================================================= */

/* ---------- 1. Design Tokens ---------- */
:root{
  /* Brand colors sampled directly from the CRAVA logo */
  --green-950:#0a1c0f;
  --green-900:#0f2a17;
  --green-800:#163a1e;
  --green-700:#1f5229;   /* brand primary green (exact logo sample) */
  --green-600:#2c6835;
  --green-400:#579c5f;
  --green-300:#8bc190;

  --gold-700:#a8720c;
  --gold-600:#c98a0e;
  --gold-500:#f1ac21;    /* brand primary gold (exact logo sample) */
  --gold-400:#ffc451;
  --gold-300:#ffd873;

  --cream:#fff6e4;       /* warm, brand-tinted background (not neutral cream) */
  --paper:#fffcf6;
  --ink:#15231a;         /* near-black, green-tinted text color */
  --ink-soft:#4a564c;
  --white:#fffefb;

  --font-display:'Noto Kufi Arabic', 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, sans-serif;
  --font-body:'Vazirmatn', 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, sans-serif;

  --container:1200px;
  --radius-lg:28px;
  --radius-md:18px;
  --radius-sm:10px;

  --ease:cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1);
  --ease-soft:cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);
}

/* ---------- 2. Reset ---------- */
*,*::before,*::after{ box-sizing:border-box; margin:0; padding:0; }
html{ scroll-behavior:smooth; }
body{
  font-family:var(--font-body);
  color:var(--ink);
  background:var(--paper);
  line-height:1.6;
  overflow-x:hidden;
  -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
}
img{ max-width:100%; display:block; }
a{ color:inherit; text-decoration:none; }
ul{ list-style:none; }
button{ font:inherit; background:none; border:none; cursor:pointer; }
h1,h2,h3,h4{ font-family:var(--font-display); font-weight:800; line-height:1.15; }
.container{ max-width:var(--container); margin-inline:auto; padding-inline:24px; }

:focus-visible{ outline:3px solid var(--gold-500); outline-offset:3px; border-radius:4px; }

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){
  *,*::before,*::after{ animation-duration:0.001ms !important; animation-iteration-count:1 !important; transition-duration:0.001ms !important; scroll-behavior:auto !important; }
}

/* ---------- 3. Reusable bits ---------- */
.eyebrow{
  display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px;
  font-size:.85rem; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.02em;
  padding:6px 16px; border-radius:100px;
  margin-bottom:16px;
}
.eyebrow--green{ background:rgba(31,82,41,.08); color:var(--green-700); }
.eyebrow--gold{ background:rgba(241,172,33,.12); color:var(--gold-400); }
.eyebrow::before{ content:''; width:6px; height:6px; border-radius:50%; background:currentColor; }

.section-head{ max-width:640px; margin-bottom:56px; }
.section-title{ font-size:clamp(2rem,4.2vw,3rem); margin-bottom:14px; }
.section-desc{ color:var(--ink-soft); font-size:1.05rem; max-width:520px; }
.dark-zone .section-desc{ color:#c7d3c8; }

.btn{
  display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:10px;
  font-family:var(--font-body); font-weight:700; font-size:1rem;
  padding:16px 30px; border-radius:100px;
  transition:transform .35s var(--ease), box-shadow .35s var(--ease), background .3s;
  cursor:pointer; border:2px solid transparent;
}
.btn svg{ width:18px; height:18px; transition:transform .3s var(--ease); }
.btn--primary{
  background:linear-gradient(95deg,var(--green-700),var(--green-600));
  color:var(--white);
  box-shadow:0 10px 30px -8px rgba(31,82,41,.55);
}
.btn--primary:hover{ transform:translateY(-4px) scale(1.03); box-shadow:0 16px 36px -8px rgba(31,82,41,.65); }
.btn--primary:hover svg{ transform:translateX(-4px); }
.btn--gold{
  background:linear-gradient(95deg,var(--gold-500),var(--gold-400));
  color:var(--green-950);
  box-shadow:0 10px 30px -8px rgba(241,172,33,.45);
}
.btn--gold:hover{ transform:translateY(-4px) scale(1.03); }

/* scroll-reveal base */
.reveal{ opacity:0; transform:translateY(36px); transition:opacity .8s var(--ease), transform .8s var(--ease); }
.reveal.is-visible{ opacity:1; transform:translateY(0); }
.reveal-stagger > *{ opacity:0; transform:translateY(28px); transition:opacity .7s var(--ease), transform .7s var(--ease); }
.reveal-stagger.is-visible > *{ opacity:1; transform:translateY(0); }

/* =========================================================================
   4. NAV
   ========================================================================= */
.nav{
  position:fixed; inset-inline:0; top:0; z-index:100;
  padding:18px 0;
  transition:background .4s var(--ease), padding .4s var(--ease), box-shadow .4s var(--ease);
}
.nav.is-scrolled{
  background:rgba(255,252,246,.85);
  backdrop-filter:blur(14px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(14px);
  padding:12px 0;
  box-shadow:0 6px 24px -12px rgba(15,42,23,.25);
}
.nav__inner{ display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:20px; }
.nav__brand{ display:flex; align-items:center; }
.nav__logo{ height:38px; width:auto; transition:transform .3s var(--ease); }
.nav__brand:hover .nav__logo{ transform:scale(1.06) rotate(-2deg); }

.nav__links{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:34px; }
.nav__link{
  position:relative; font-weight:600; font-size:.98rem; color:var(--ink);
  padding:6px 2px;
}
.nav__link::after{
  content:''; position:absolute; right:0; bottom:-2px; height:2px; width:0;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--gold-500),var(--green-700));
  transition:width .35s var(--ease);
}
.nav__link:hover::after, .nav__link.active::after{ width:100%; }
.nav__link.active{ color:var(--green-700); }

.nav__cta{
  background:var(--green-700); color:var(--white); font-weight:700;
  font-size:.92rem; padding:11px 24px; border-radius:100px;
  transition:background .3s, transform .3s var(--ease);
}
.nav__cta:hover{ background:var(--gold-500); color:var(--green-950); transform:translateY(-2px); }

.nav__burger{ display:none; flex-direction:column; gap:5px; width:32px; z-index:110; }
.nav__burger span{ height:2.5px; width:100%; background:var(--ink); border-radius:2px; transition:transform .35s var(--ease), opacity .3s; }
.nav__burger.is-open span:nth-child(1){ transform:translateY(7.5px) rotate(45deg); }
.nav__burger.is-open span:nth-child(2){ opacity:0; }
.nav__burger.is-open span:nth-child(3){ transform:translateY(-7.5px) rotate(-45deg); }

/* =========================================================================
   5. HERO
   ========================================================================= */
.hero{
  position:relative;
  min-height:100vh;
  display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
  padding:120px 0 60px;
  overflow:hidden;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 18% 20%, rgba(241,172,33,.16), transparent 55%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 82% 78%, rgba(31,82,41,.14), transparent 55%),
    var(--paper);
}
.hero__blobs{ position:absolute; inset:0; z-index:0; pointer-events:none; }
.blob{
  position:absolute; border-radius:50%; filter:blur(2px);
  animation:float 9s ease-in-out infinite;
  opacity:.55;
}
.blob--1{ width:170px; height:170px; background:radial-gradient(circle,var(--gold-300),transparent 70%); top:14%; left:10%; animation-delay:0s; }
.blob--2{ width:120px; height:120px; background:radial-gradient(circle,var(--green-300),transparent 70%); top:62%; left:6%; animation-delay:1.4s; }
.blob--3{ width:90px; height:90px; background:radial-gradient(circle,var(--gold-400),transparent 70%); top:22%; right:9%; animation-delay:.7s; }
.blob--4{ width:210px; height:210px; background:radial-gradient(circle,var(--green-300),transparent 70%); bottom:6%; right:12%; animation-delay:2.1s; }
.blob--5{ width:60px; height:60px; background:radial-gradient(circle,var(--gold-300),transparent 70%); top:46%; right:26%; animation-delay:3s; }
@keyframes float{
  0%,100%{ transform:translateY(0) translateX(0); }
  50%{ transform:translateY(-26px) translateX(10px); }
}

.hero__inner{ position:relative; z-index:2; text-align:center; display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; }
.hero__logo{
  width:min(280px,58vw); margin-bottom:22px;
  opacity:0; transform:scale(.8) translateY(-16px);
  animation:logoIn 1s var(--ease) .1s forwards;
  filter:drop-shadow(0 14px 26px rgba(15,42,23,.18));
}
@keyframes logoIn{ to{ opacity:1; transform:scale(1) translateY(0); } }

.hero__badge{
  display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px;
  background:var(--green-950); color:var(--gold-400);
  font-weight:700; font-size:.85rem; letter-spacing:.02em;
  padding:9px 20px; border-radius:100px; margin-bottom:26px;
  opacity:0; animation:fadeUp .8s var(--ease) .4s forwards;
}
.hero__badge::before{ content:''; width:7px; height:7px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--gold-500); box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(241,172,33,.25); }

.hero__title{ font-size:clamp(2.6rem,7vw,5rem); letter-spacing:-.01em; }
.hero__title .line{ display:block; opacity:0; transform:translateY(40px); animation:fadeUp .9s var(--ease) forwards; }
.hero__title .line--green{ color:var(--green-700); animation-delay:.55s; }
.hero__title .line--gold{ color:var(--gold-500); animation-delay:.75s; -webkit-text-stroke:1px rgba(31,82,41,.12); }
@keyframes fadeUp{ to{ opacity:1; transform:translateY(0); } }

.hero__subtitle{
  margin-top:22px; font-size:1.15rem; color:var(--ink-soft); max-width:460px;
  opacity:0; animation:fadeUp .9s var(--ease) .95s forwards;
}
.hero__inner .btn{ margin-top:36px; opacity:0; animation:fadeUp .9s var(--ease) 1.15s forwards; }

.hero__scroll{
  margin-top:44px;
  opacity:0; animation:fadeUp .9s var(--ease) 1.4s forwards;
}
.hero__scroll span{
  display:block; width:22px; height:36px; border:2px solid var(--ink-soft); border-radius:100px; position:relative;
}
.hero__scroll span::before{
  content:''; position:absolute; top:6px; right:50%; width:4px; height:4px; margin-right:-2px;
  background:var(--green-700); border-radius:50%;
  animation:scrollDot 1.6s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes scrollDot{ 0%{ transform:translateY(0); opacity:1; } 70%{ transform:translateY(14px); opacity:0; } 100%{ opacity:0; } }

/* wave divider — the signature motif, echoing the swoop under the CRAVA wordmark */
.wave-divider{ position:relative; width:100%; line-height:0; z-index:3; }
.wave-divider--hero{ position:absolute; inset-inline:0; bottom:0; }
.wave-divider svg{ width:100%; height:auto; display:block; }
.wave-line{
  fill:none; stroke-width:5; stroke-linecap:round;
  stroke-dasharray:1600; stroke-dashoffset:1600;
  transition:stroke-dashoffset 1.6s var(--ease);
}
.wave-divider.is-visible .wave-line{ stroke-dashoffset:0; }

/* =========================================================================
   6. JUICE SECTION
   ========================================================================= */
.juices{
  position:relative;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 90% 0%, rgba(241,172,33,.10), transparent 45%),
    var(--cream);
  padding:20px 0 100px;
  overflow:hidden;
}

.juice-feature{
  position:relative; display:flex; justify-content:center; margin-bottom:70px;
}
.juice-feature__art{
  position:relative; width:min(340px,80vw);
  animation:bob 6s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes bob{ 0%,100%{ transform:translateY(0) rotate(-1.4deg); } 50%{ transform:translateY(-16px) rotate(1.4deg); } }
.juice-feature__img{
  width:100%; border-radius:32px;
  box-shadow:0 30px 60px -20px rgba(31,82,41,.35), 0 0 0 10px var(--white);
}
.droplet{
  position:absolute; border-radius:50% 50% 50% 4px; transform:rotate(45deg);
  background:linear-gradient(160deg,var(--gold-400),var(--gold-600));
  box-shadow:0 6px 14px -4px rgba(200,138,14,.5);
  animation:drip 3.2s ease-in-out infinite;
}
.droplet.d1{ width:22px; height:22px; top:-14px; right:18%; animation-delay:0s; }
.droplet.d2{ width:14px; height:14px; top:20%; left:-10px; background:linear-gradient(160deg,var(--green-400),var(--green-700)); animation-delay:1s; }
.droplet.d3{ width:17px; height:17px; bottom:8%; right:-8px; animation-delay:2s; }
@keyframes drip{ 0%,100%{ transform:translateY(0) rotate(45deg); } 50%{ transform:translateY(14px) rotate(45deg); } }

.juice-grid{
  display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(190px,1fr)); gap:26px;
}
.juice-card{
  position:relative; background:var(--white); border-radius:var(--radius-md);
  padding:26px 18px 22px; text-align:center;
  box-shadow:0 8px 24px -14px rgba(21,35,26,.18);
  transition:transform .45s var(--ease), box-shadow .45s var(--ease);
}
.juice-card:hover{
  transform:translateY(-10px) rotate(-1deg);
  box-shadow:0 22px 40px -16px rgba(21,35,26,.28);
}
.juice-cup{ position:relative; width:56px; height:64px; margin:0 auto 16px; }
.juice-cup__body{
  position:absolute; inset:8px 4px 0; border-radius:4px 4px 10px 10px;
  clip-path:polygon(12% 0%,88% 0%,78% 100%,22% 100%);
  background:var(--cup-grad, linear-gradient(160deg,var(--gold-400),var(--gold-600)));
  transition:transform .45s var(--ease);
}
.juice-cup__lid{
  position:absolute; top:0; left:50%; transform:translateX(-50%);
  width:100%; height:12px; border-radius:50%;
  background:var(--cup-grad, linear-gradient(160deg,var(--gold-300),var(--gold-500)));
  box-shadow:0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.08);
}
.juice-cup__straw{
  position:absolute; top:-16px; right:32%; width:6px; height:26px; border-radius:3px;
  background:var(--green-600); transform:rotate(14deg); transform-origin:bottom;
  transition:transform .45s var(--ease);
}
.juice-card:hover .juice-cup__straw{ transform:rotate(24deg) translateY(-3px); }
.juice-card:hover .juice-cup__body{ transform:scale(1.08); }

.juice-card__name{ font-family:var(--font-display); font-weight:700; font-size:1.02rem; margin-bottom:6px; }
.juice-card__price{
  display:inline-block; font-weight:700; font-size:.92rem; color:var(--gold-700);
  background:rgba(241,172,33,.12); padding:4px 14px; border-radius:100px;
  transition:transform .35s var(--ease), background .35s, color .35s;
}
.juice-card:hover .juice-card__price{ background:var(--green-700); color:var(--white); transform:scale(1.06); }

/* =========================================================================
   7. DARK ZONE — FRIES + SAUCES (shared moody backdrop)
   ========================================================================= */
.dark-zone{
  position:relative;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 50% 0%, rgba(241,172,33,.16), transparent 55%),
    linear-gradient(180deg,var(--green-950) 0%, var(--green-900) 55%, var(--green-950) 100%);
  color:var(--white);
  overflow:hidden;
}
.dark-zone::before{
  content:''; position:absolute; inset:0;
  background-image:radial-gradient(rgba(241,172,33,.18) 1px, transparent 1.4px);
  background-size:26px 26px;
  opacity:.35; pointer-events:none;
}

.fries{ position:relative; padding:110px 0 70px; }
.fries .eyebrow--gold{ color:var(--gold-400); }
.fries .section-title{ color:var(--white); }

.fries-feature{ position:relative; display:flex; justify-content:center; margin-bottom:66px; }
.fries-feature__glow{
  position:absolute; width:340px; height:340px; border-radius:50%;
  background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(241,172,33,.45),transparent 68%);
  filter:blur(10px); z-index:0; animation:pulseGlow 4s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes pulseGlow{ 0%,100%{ opacity:.7; transform:scale(1); } 50%{ opacity:1; transform:scale(1.08); } }
.fries-feature__art{ position:relative; width:min(280px,76vw); z-index:1; animation:bob 7s ease-in-out infinite; }
.fries-feature__img{
  width:100%; border-radius:26px;
  box-shadow:0 30px 70px -18px rgba(0,0,0,.6);
}
.steam{ position:absolute; inset:0; pointer-events:none; z-index:2; }
.steam span{
  position:absolute; bottom:10%; width:8px; height:8px; border-radius:50%;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.5); filter:blur(3px);
  animation:steamRise 4.5s ease-in infinite;
}

.fries-grid{ display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(210px,1fr)); gap:22px; }
.fries-card{
  position:relative; background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);
  border-radius:var(--radius-md); padding:28px 22px;
  backdrop-filter:blur(6px);
  overflow:hidden;
  transition:transform .45s var(--ease), border-color .45s, background .45s;
}
.fries-card::after{
  content:''; position:absolute; inset:0; border-radius:inherit;
  background:linear-gradient(120deg,transparent 40%,rgba(241,172,33,.22) 50%,transparent 60%);
  transform:translateX(-120%); transition:transform .7s var(--ease);
}
.fries-card:hover{ transform:translateY(-8px); border-color:rgba(241,172,33,.5); background:rgba(255,255,255,.06); }
.fries-card:hover::after{ transform:translateX(120%); }

.fries-cone{ position:relative; width:40px; height:48px; margin-bottom:16px; }
.fries-cone__body{
  position:absolute; inset:6px 6px 0; clip-path:polygon(8% 0%,92% 0%,58% 100%,42% 100%);
  background:linear-gradient(160deg,var(--white),var(--gold-300) 60%,var(--green-700));
}
.fries-cone__stick{ position:absolute; top:-6px; width:4px; height:18px; background:var(--gold-500); border-radius:2px; }
.fries-cone__stick.s1{ right:24%; transform:rotate(-8deg); }
.fries-cone__stick.s2{ right:48%; transform:rotate(4deg); }
.fries-cone__stick.s3{ right:66%; transform:rotate(14deg); }

.fries-card__name{ font-family:var(--font-display); font-weight:700; font-size:1.12rem; margin-bottom:8px; }
.fries-card__desc{ color:#b9c6ba; font-size:.9rem; margin-bottom:16px; }
.fries-card__price{
  display:inline-block; font-weight:700; color:var(--gold-400);
  border:1.5px solid rgba(241,172,33,.4); padding:5px 16px; border-radius:100px; font-size:.92rem;
  transition:background .35s,color .35s;
}
.fries-card:hover .fries-card__price{ background:var(--gold-500); color:var(--green-950); }

/* Sauces */
.sauces{ position:relative; padding:20px 0 120px; }
.sauces .section-head{ margin-bottom:46px; }
.sauce-row{ display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:34px; justify-content:flex-start; }
.sauce-card{ width:150px; text-align:center; }
.sauce-dollop{
  position:relative; width:96px; height:96px; margin:0 auto 16px;
  border-radius:46% 54% 58% 42%/50% 46% 54% 50%;
  background:var(--sauce-grad);
  box-shadow:0 14px 26px -10px rgba(0,0,0,.5), inset 0 -8px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.12), inset 0 6px 10px rgba(255,255,255,.25);
  transition:transform .5s var(--ease), border-radius .5s var(--ease);
}
.sauce-card:hover .sauce-dollop{
  transform:scale(1.1) rotate(-4deg);
  border-radius:58% 42% 46% 54%/42% 58% 42% 58%;
}
.sauce-drip{
  position:absolute; bottom:-10px; left:50%; transform:translateX(-50%);
  width:10px; height:0; border-radius:0 0 6px 6px; background:var(--sauce-grad);
  transition:height .4s var(--ease-soft);
}
.sauce-card:hover .sauce-drip{ height:16px; }
.sauce-card__name{ font-weight:700; font-size:.98rem; margin-bottom:4px; }
.sauce-card__price{ color:var(--gold-300); font-size:.86rem; font-weight:600; }

/* =========================================================================
   8. FOOTER
   ========================================================================= */
.footer{ position:relative; background:var(--green-950); color:#dce6dd; padding-top:0; }
.footer__inner{
  display:grid; grid-template-columns:1.2fr 1fr 1fr; gap:50px;
  padding:70px 0 50px;
}
.footer__logo{ height:40px; margin-bottom:16px; filter:brightness(0) invert(1) opacity(.92); }
.footer__brand p{ color:#a8b8a9; font-size:.95rem; max-width:240px; }

.footer h4{ font-family:var(--font-display); font-size:1rem; color:var(--gold-400); margin-bottom:16px; }
.footer__info p{ margin-bottom:10px; color:#cddace; }
.footer__info .pin{ display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; font-weight:600; color:var(--white); }
.footer__info .pin svg{ width:16px; height:16px; color:var(--gold-500); flex-shrink:0; }

.badge-takeaway{
  display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; margin-top:14px;
  background:rgba(241,172,33,.12); border:1px solid rgba(241,172,33,.3);
  color:var(--gold-300); font-weight:700; font-size:.85rem;
  padding:9px 16px; border-radius:100px;
}
.badge-takeaway::before{ content:'⇥'; font-size:.9rem; }
.badge-note{ margin-top:8px; font-size:.82rem; color:#8ea08f; }

.social-icons{ display:flex; gap:12px; }
.social-icons a{
  width:44px; height:44px; border-radius:50%;
  display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.06); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);
  transition:transform .35s var(--ease), background .35s, border-color .35s;
}
.social-icons a svg{ width:18px; height:18px; color:#dce6dd; transition:color .3s; }
.social-icons a:hover{ background:var(--gold-500); border-color:var(--gold-500); transform:translateY(-5px) rotate(-8deg); }
.social-icons a:hover svg{ color:var(--green-950); }

.footer__bottom{
  border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);
  padding:22px 0; text-align:center; font-size:.85rem; color:#8ea08f;
}

/* =========================================================================
   9. RESPONSIVE
   ========================================================================= */
@media (max-width:900px){
  .footer__inner{ grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; }
  .footer__brand{ grid-column:1/-1; }
}

@media (max-width:760px){
  .nav__links{
    position:fixed; inset:0 0 auto 0; top:0;
    flex-direction:column; align-items:flex-start; gap:0;
    background:var(--paper); padding:100px 28px 30px;
    transform:translateY(-100%); opacity:0;
    transition:transform .5s var(--ease), opacity .4s;
    pointer-events:none;
  }
  .nav__links.is-open{ transform:translateY(0); opacity:1; pointer-events:auto; box-shadow:0 20px 40px -20px rgba(15,42,23,.3); }
  .nav__link{ width:100%; padding:16px 0; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(21,35,26,.08); font-size:1.1rem; }
  .nav__cta{ display:none; }
  .nav__burger{ display:flex; }

  .hero{ padding:110px 0 50px; }
  .hero__subtitle{ font-size:1.02rem; }

  .juice-grid{ grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(140px,1fr)); gap:16px; }
  .juice-card{ padding:20px 12px 16px; }

  .fries-grid{ grid-template-columns:1fr; }
  .sauce-row{ justify-content:center; gap:22px; }
  .sauce-card{ width:120px; }
  .sauce-dollop{ width:78px; height:78px; }

  .footer__inner{ grid-template-columns:1fr; gap:36px; padding:56px 0 40px; }
}

@media (max-width:420px){
  .juice-grid{ grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr); }
  .hero__title{ font-size:clamp(2.1rem,10vw,3rem); }
}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<!-- ============================= NAV ============================= -->
<header class="nav" id="nav">
  <div class="nav__inner container">
    <a href="#home" class="nav__brand" aria-label="کراڤا">
      <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="کراڤا" class="nav__logo">
    </a>

    <nav class="nav__links" id="navLinks">
      <a href="#home" class="nav__link active" data-link>سەرەتا</a>
      <a href="#juices" class="nav__link" data-link>شەربەت</a>
      <a href="#fries" class="nav__link" data-link>چیپس</a>
      <a href="#sauces" class="nav__link" data-link>سۆس</a>
      <a href="#contact" class="nav__link" data-link>پەیوەندی</a>
    </nav>

    <a href="#juices" class="nav__cta">داواکردن</a>

    <button class="nav__burger" id="navBurger" aria-label="کردنەوەی مینیو" aria-expanded="false">
      <span></span><span></span><span></span>
    </button>
  </div>
</header>

<main>

  <!-- ============================= HERO ============================= -->
  <section class="hero" id="home">
    <div class="hero__blobs" aria-hidden="true">
      <span class="blob blob--1"></span>
      <span class="blob blob--2"></span>
      <span class="blob blob--3"></span>
      <span class="blob blob--4"></span>
      <span class="blob blob--5"></span>
    </div>

    <div class="hero__inner container">
      <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="کراڤا" class="hero__logo">

      <p class="hero__badge">تەنها بۆ بردنەوە</p>

      <h1 class="hero__title">
        <span class="line line--green">شەربەتی تازە</span>
        <span class="line line--gold">چیپسی ترسکە</span>
      </h1>

      <p class="hero__subtitle">لە شەقامی کاوە — هەموو ڕۆژێک تازە ئامادەکراو، تەنها چاوەڕوانی تۆیە.</p>

      <a href="#juices" class="btn btn--primary">
        بینینی مێنیو
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M12 5v14M6 13l6 6 6-6"/></svg>
      </a>

      <div class="hero__scroll" aria-hidden="true"><span></span></div>
    </div>

    <div class="wave-divider wave-divider--hero" id="wave1">
      <svg viewBox="0 0 1200 100" preserveAspectRatio="none">
        <defs>
          <linearGradient id="grad1" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
            <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#f1ac21"/>
            <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#1f5229"/>
          </linearGradient>
        </defs>
        <path d="M0,55 C220,10 420,95 700,50 C900,15 1050,70 1200,40" class="wave-line" stroke="url(#grad1)"/>
        <path d="M0,70 L0,100 L1200,100 L1200,55 C1050,85 900,30 700,65 C420,110 220,25 0,70 Z" fill="var(--cream)"/>
      </svg>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- ============================= JUICE SECTION ============================= -->
  <section class="juices" id="juices">
    <div class="container">

      <div class="section-head reveal">
        <span class="eyebrow eyebrow--green">تازە هەموو ڕۆژێک</span>
        <h2 class="section-title">شەربەتە تازەکان</h2>
        <p class="section-desc">١٥ جۆر شەربەتی تازە بۆ هەر سلیقەیەک — لە بەروبووم کراوە، بەبێ هیچ زیادکراوێکی دەستکرد.</p>
      </div>

      <div class="juice-feature reveal">
        <div class="juice-feature__art">
          <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64, alt="جامی شەربەتی تازەی کراڤا پڕ لە بەروبووم" class="juice-feature__img">
          <span class="droplet d1"></span>
          <span class="droplet d2"></span>
          <span class="droplet d3"></span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="juice-grid reveal-stagger" id="juiceGrid">
        <!-- Juice cards injected by JS from data array -->
      </div>

    </div>
  </section>
<!-- ============================= ICE CRAVA SECTION ============================= -->
  <section class="icecrava" id="icecrava" style="padding: 60px 0 80px; background: var(--white);">
    <div class="container">

      <div class="section-head reveal" style="margin-bottom: 40px; text-align: center; margin-inline: auto;">
        <span class="eyebrow eyebrow--gold">تایبەت بە کراڤا</span>
        <h2 class="section-title">ئایسکڕاڤا</h2>
        <p class="section-desc" style="margin-inline: auto;">تێکەڵەیەکی نایاب لە شوتی فرێش و ئایسکرێم — فێنککەرەوەیەکی تەواو بۆ ڕۆژە گەرمەکان، تەنها لای ئێمە دەستدەکەوێت.</p>
      </div>

      <!-- نیشاندانی وێنە تایبەتەکەی ئایسکڕاڤا -->
      <div class="fries-feature reveal" style="margin-bottom: 30px;">
        <!-- ڕەنگی پشتەوەی سێبەرەکەمان گۆڕی بۆ پەمەیی/سوور تا لەگەڵ شوتییەکە بگونجێت -->
        <span class="fries-feature__glow" style="background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255, 77, 109, 0.3), transparent 68%);" aria-hidden="true"></span>
        <div class="fries-feature__art" style="width: min(320px, 80vw);">
          <img src="image_2.png" alt="ئایسکڕاڤا - شوتی و ئایسکرێم" class="juice-feature__img" style="border-radius: 20px;">
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- ناو و نرخی ئایسکڕاڤا -->
      <div class="reveal" style="text-align: center;">
        <h3 class="juice-card__name" style="font-size: 1.4rem; margin-bottom: 10px;">ئایسکڕاڤای شوتی</h3>
        <span class="juice-card__price" style="font-size: 1.1rem; padding: 6px 20px;">3,000 IQD</span>
      </div>

    </div>
  </section>
  <!-- ============================= DARK ZONE: FRIES + SAUCES ============================= -->
  <div class="dark-zone">

    <div class="wave-divider wave-divider--tofries" id="wave2">
      <svg viewBox="0 0 1200 100" preserveAspectRatio="none">
        <defs>
          <linearGradient id="grad2" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
            <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#1f5229"/>
            <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#f1ac21"/>
          </linearGradient>
        </defs>
        <path d="M0,45 C240,90 460,5 720,55 C920,95 1060,20 1200,60" class="wave-line" stroke="url(#grad2)"/>
        <path d="M0,30 L0,0 L1200,0 L1200,45 C1060,5 920,80 720,40 C460,-10 240,75 0,30 Z" fill="var(--green-950)"/>
      </svg>
    </div>

    <section class="fries" id="fries">
      <div class="container">

        <div class="section-head reveal">
          <span class="eyebrow eyebrow--gold">ترسکە و گەرم</span>
          <h2 class="section-title">چیپسەکان</h2>
          <p class="section-desc">٥ جۆر چیپسی ترسکە، بە تامێکی جیاواز بۆ هەر جارێک — ڕاستەوخۆ لە سووتەکەوە بۆ گەڵادانەکەت.</p>
        </div>

        <div class="fries-feature reveal">
          <span class="fries-feature__glow" aria-hidden="true"></span>
          <div class="fries-feature__art">
            <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="گەڵادانی چیپسی ترسکەی کراڤا" class="fries-feature__img">
          </div>
          <div class="steam" id="steamContainer" aria-hidden="true"></div>
        </div>

        <div class="fries-grid reveal-stagger" id="friesGrid">
          <!-- Fries cards injected by JS -->
        </div>

      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="sauces" id="sauces">
      <div class="container">

        <div class="section-head reveal">
          <span class="eyebrow eyebrow--gold">تامی زیاد</span>
          <h2 class="section-title">سۆسە تایبەتەکان</h2>
          <p class="section-desc">٥ جۆر سۆس، بۆ ئەوەی چیپسەکەت تەواو بکەیت.</p>
        </div>

        <div class="sauce-row reveal-stagger" id="sauceRow">
          <!-- Sauce cards injected by JS -->
        </div>

      </div>
    </section>

  </div>

</main>

<!-- ============================= FOOTER ============================= -->
<footer class="footer" id="contact">
  <div class="wave-divider wave-divider--footer" id="wave3">
    <svg viewBox="0 0 1200 80" preserveAspectRatio="none">
      <defs>
        <linearGradient id="grad3" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
          <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#f1ac21"/>
          <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#1f5229"/>
        </linearGradient>
      </defs>
      <path d="M0,40 C260,75 480,5 720,42 C920,74 1060,10 1200,38" class="wave-line" stroke="url(#grad3)" stroke-width="4"/>
      <path d="M0,25 L0,0 L1200,0 L1200,40 C1060,12 920,76 720,44 C480,7 260,77 0,25 Z" fill="var(--green-900)"/>
    </svg>
  </div>

  <div class="container footer__inner">

    <div class="footer__brand">
      <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="کراڤا" class="footer__logo">
      <p>شەربەتی تازە و چیپسی ترسکە — هەموو ڕۆژێک، تەنها چاوەڕوانی تۆیە.</p>
    </div>

    <div class="footer__info">
      <h4>شوێنمان</h4>
      <p class="pin">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M12 21s7-6.5 7-11.5A7 7 0 0 0 5 9.5C5 14.5 12 21 12 21z"/><circle cx="12" cy="9.5" r="2.5"/></svg>
        شەقامی کاوە
      </p>
      <span class="badge-takeaway">تەنها بۆ بردنەوە</span>
      <p class="badge-note">کراڤا شوێنی دانیشتن نییە — تەنها خزمەتگوزاری بردنەوە.</p>
    </div>

    <div class="footer__social">
      <h4>شوێنمان بدۆزەرەوە</h4>
      <div class="social-icons">
        <a href="#" aria-label="Instagram">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><rect x="3" y="3" width="18" height="18" rx="5"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="4"/><circle cx="17.5" cy="6.5" r="1"/></svg>
        </a>
        <a href="#" aria-label="Facebook">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M18 2h-3a5 5 0 0 0-5 5v3H7v4h3v8h4v-8h3l1-4h-4V7a1 1 0 0 1 1-1h3z"/></svg>
        </a>
        <a href="#" aria-label="WhatsApp">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M21 11.5a8.5 8.5 0 0 1-12.4 7.5L3 20l1.1-5.4A8.5 8.5 0 1 1 21 11.5z"/><path d="M8.5 9.5c0 4 3 7 7 7"/></svg>
        </a>
        <a href="#" aria-label="TikTok">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M15 3v11.5a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-3.5-3.5"/><path d="M15 3c0 2.5 2 4.5 4.5 4.5"/></svg>
        </a>
      </div>
    </div>

  </div>

  <div class="footer__bottom">
    <p>© 2026 کراڤا. هەموو مافەکان پارێزراون.</p>
  </div>
</footer>

<script>
/* =========================================================================
   CRAVA — script.js (inline)
   Sections: 1. Menu data  2. Card rendering  3. Nav behavior
   4. Scroll reveal  5. Wave dividers  6. Steam particles  7. Misc UX
   ========================================================================= */

/* ---------- 1. Menu data (Kurdish placeholder names + dummy prices) ---------- */
const JUICES = [
  { name:'شەربەتی پرتەقاڵ',        price:'2000 د.ع', grad:'linear-gradient(160deg,#ff8a24,#f1ac21)' },
  { name:'شەربەتی سێو',            price:'2000 د.ع', grad:'linear-gradient(160deg,#9ccc65,#558b2f)' },
  { name:'شەربەتی هەنار',          price:'2500 د.ع', grad:'linear-gradient(160deg,#c2185b,#880e4f)' },
  { name:'شەربەتی مۆز',            price:'2000 د.ع', grad:'linear-gradient(160deg,#ffd873,#f1ac21)' },
  { name:'شەربەتی کیوی',           price:'2500 د.ع', grad:'linear-gradient(160deg,#8bc34a,#33691e)' },
  { name:'شەربەتی مانگۆ',          price:'3000 د.ع', grad:'linear-gradient(160deg,#ffb300,#ff6f00)' },
  { name:'شەربەتی ئەنەناس',        price:'3000 د.ع', grad:'linear-gradient(160deg,#fdd835,#f9a825)' },
  { name:'شەربەتی فرەولە',         price:'2500 د.ع', grad:'linear-gradient(160deg,#ef5350,#c62828)' },
  { name:'شەربەتی لیمۆ',           price:'2000 د.ع', grad:'linear-gradient(160deg,#d4e157,#afb42b)' },
  { name:'شەربەتی هەنجیر',         price:'3000 د.ع', grad:'linear-gradient(160deg,#8e24aa,#4a148c)' },
  { name:'تێکەڵاوی گەرمسێری',      price:'3500 د.ع', grad:'linear-gradient(160deg,#ff7043,#ec407a)' },
  { name:'تێکەڵاوی وەرزی',         price:'3500 د.ع', grad:'linear-gradient(160deg,#66bb6a,#f1ac21)' },
  { name:'شەربەتی سەوزە',          price:'3000 د.ع', grad:'linear-gradient(160deg,#43a047,#1f5229)' },
  { name:'شەربەتی وزەبەخش',        price:'3500 د.ع', grad:'linear-gradient(160deg,#f1ac21,#c98a0e)' },
  { name:'شەربەتی تایبەتی کراڤا',  price:'4000 د.ع', grad:'linear-gradient(160deg,#1f5229,#f1ac21)' },
];

const FRIES = [
  { name:'چیپسی ئاسایی',           desc:'ترسکەی کلاسیک، خۆشی سادە.',      price:'3000 د.ع' },
  { name:'چیپسی پەنیری زێدە',      desc:'داپۆشراو بە پەنیری زۆر.',         price:'4000 د.ع' },
  { name:'چیپسی تیژ',              desc:'بۆ ئەوانەی حەز بە تیژی دەکەن.', price:'3500 د.ع' },
  { name:'چیپسی تێکەڵ',            desc:'تێکەڵەیەک لە تام و ڕازاندنەوە.', price:'4500 د.ع' },
  { name:'چیپسی تایبەتی کراڤا',    desc:'ڕێکردی تایبەتی کراڤا.',           price:'5000 د.ع' },
];

const SAUCES = [
  { name:'سۆسی تایبەتی کراڤا', price:'1000 د.ع', grad:'linear-gradient(150deg,#1f5229,#f1ac21)' },
  { name:'سۆسی پەنیر',         price:'750 د.ع',  grad:'linear-gradient(150deg,#ffe29a,#f1ac21)' },
  { name:'سۆسی تیژ',           price:'750 د.ع',  grad:'linear-gradient(150deg,#ff7043,#d84315)' },
  { name:'سۆسی سیر',           price:'750 د.ع',  grad:'linear-gradient(150deg,#fffdf5,#e8dfc8)' },
  { name:'سۆسی تەماتە',        price:'500 د.ع',  grad:'linear-gradient(150deg,#ef5350,#b71c1c)' },
];

/* ---------- 2. Render cards ---------- */
function renderJuices(){
  const grid = document.getElementById('juiceGrid');
  grid.innerHTML = JUICES.map(j => `
    <article class="juice-card">
      <div class="juice-cup" style="--cup-grad:${j.grad}">
        <span class="juice-cup__straw"></span>
        <span class="juice-cup__lid"></span>
        <span class="juice-cup__body"></span>
      </div>
      <h3 class="juice-card__name">${j.name}</h3>
      <p class="juice-card__price">${j.price}</p>
    </article>
  `).join('');
}

function renderFries(){
  const grid = document.getElementById('friesGrid');
  grid.innerHTML = FRIES.map(f => `
    <article class="fries-card">
      <div class="fries-cone">
        <span class="fries-cone__stick s1"></span>
        <span class="fries-cone__stick s2"></span>
        <span class="fries-cone__stick s3"></span>
        <span class="fries-cone__body"></span>
      </div>
      <h3 class="fries-card__name">${f.name}</h3>
      <p class="fries-card__desc">${f.desc}</p>
      <span class="fries-card__price">${f.price}</span>
    </article>
  `).join('');
}

function renderSauces(){
  const row = document.getElementById('sauceRow');
  row.innerHTML = SAUCES.map(s => `
    <article class="sauce-card">
      <div class="sauce-dollop" style="--sauce-grad:${s.grad}">
        <span class="sauce-drip" style="--sauce-grad:${s.grad}"></span>
      </div>
      <p class="sauce-card__name">${s.name}</p>
      <p class="sauce-card__price">${s.price}</p>
    </article>
  `).join('');
}

renderJuices();
renderFries();
renderSauces();

/* ---------- 3. Nav behavior ---------- */
const nav = document.getElementById('nav');
const burger = document.getElementById('navBurger');
const navLinks = document.getElementById('navLinks');

window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
  nav.classList.toggle('is-scrolled', window.scrollY > 40);
}, { passive:true });

burger.addEventListener('click', () => {
  const open = navLinks.classList.toggle('is-open');
  burger.classList.toggle('is-open', open);
  burger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', open);
});

document.querySelectorAll('[data-link]').forEach(link => {
  link.addEventListener('click', () => {
    navLinks.classList.remove('is-open');
    burger.classList.remove('is-open');
    burger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', false);
  });
});

/* Active link highlight on scroll */
const sections = ['home','juices','fries','sauces','contact']
  .map(id => document.getElementById(id)).filter(Boolean);
const navLinkEls = document.querySelectorAll('[data-link]');

const navObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
  entries.forEach(entry => {
    if (entry.isIntersecting) {
      const id = entry.target.id;
      navLinkEls.forEach(l => l.classList.toggle('active', l.getAttribute('href') === '#' + id));
    }
  });
}, { rootMargin: '-45% 0px -50% 0px' });
sections.forEach(s => navObserver.observe(s));

/* ---------- 4. Scroll reveal ---------- */
const revealObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
  entries.forEach(entry => {
    if (entry.isIntersecting){
      entry.target.classList.add('is-visible');
      revealObserver.unobserve(entry.target);
    }
  });
}, { threshold:0.15 });
document.querySelectorAll('.reveal, .reveal-stagger').forEach(el => revealObserver.observe(el));

/* ---------- 5. Wave dividers draw-in ---------- */
const waveObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
  entries.forEach(entry => {
    if (entry.isIntersecting){
      entry.target.classList.add('is-visible');
      waveObserver.unobserve(entry.target);
    }
  });
}, { threshold:0.3 });
document.querySelectorAll('.wave-divider').forEach(el => waveObserver.observe(el));

/* ---------- 6. Steam particles (fries section ambience) ---------- */
const steamContainer = document.getElementById('steamContainer');
const reduceMotion = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

if (steamContainer && !reduceMotion){
  const STEAM_COUNT = 10;
  for (let i = 0; i < STEAM_COUNT; i++){
    const p = document.createElement('span');
    const left = 30 + Math.random() * 40;
    const delay = Math.random() * 4.5;
    const duration = 3.5 + Math.random() * 2.5;
    const size = 5 + Math.random() * 6;
    p.style.left = left + '%';
    p.style.width = size + 'px';
    p.style.height = size + 'px';
    p.style.animationDelay = delay + 's';
    p.style.animationDuration = duration + 's';
    steamContainer.appendChild(p);
  }
  const style = document.createElement('style');
  style.textContent = `
    @keyframes steamRise{
      0%{ transform:translateY(0) scale(1); opacity:0; }
      15%{ opacity:.55; }
      100%{ transform:translateY(-160px) scale(1.8); opacity:0; }
    }`;
  document.head.appendChild(style);
}

/* ---------- 7. Hero blob parallax on pointer move (desktop only, motion-safe) ---------- */
const heroBlobs = document.querySelector('.hero__blobs');
if (heroBlobs && !reduceMotion && window.matchMedia('(pointer:fine)').matches){
  document.querySelector('.hero').addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
    const { innerWidth:w, innerHeight:h } = window;
    const x = (e.clientX / w - 0.5) * 18;
    const y = (e.clientY / h - 0.5) * 18;
    heroBlobs.style.transform = `translate(${x}px, ${y}px)`;
  });
}
</script>
</body>
</html>
